title: Darius Longimanus
summary: Raleigh names Darius Longimanus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Darius Longimanus, in Metasthenes his catalogue, who is giuen 37 yeares. He is not Artaxerxes Longimanus, and not Darius Nothus. The one-word title would fold onto the men titled Darius, so the title is two words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
